VI.description: Headless DQMH Remove Do Something. Removes the example Do Something events from ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project by calling Delacor's Remove Do Something.vi as a STATIC subVI\2C wired exactly as Delacor's Script New Module.vi wires it when a new module is created without them.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi with an empty Event Name (parse\2C pick the module by NAME\2C close the other modules) -> lvdqmh_find_testers.vi for the module's API tester -> Application\3AUnattended Mode TRUE -> Remove Do Something.vi with Removal Target = Single Module\2C Module Library = the module's library\2C Project unwired and Exact Tester to Match = the tester path -> Unattended Mode FALSE -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi.\0A\0AUNATTENDED MODE\2C AS DELACOR DOES IT. Script New Module.vi turns Application\3AUnattended Mode on around this call because closing the VIs that call the Do Something VIs can raise save prompts\3B a prompt is a modal\2C and a modal stops LabVIEW's gRPC service. It is switched off again after an error as well\2C through Clear Errors.vi\2C and the error of that write is dropped as Delacor drops it\3B error out carries Remove Do Something.vi's own. Project stays unwired as in Script New Module.vi\3A Remove Do Something.vi reads it only for a project template.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module and its API tester found\2C no locked and no unsaved module\2C and no error. Event Names lists the module's events\2C so a caller sees whether any Do Something event is left. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index -1. Scripted? says whether Remove Do Something.vi was called.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi\2C lvdqmh_find_testers.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
